title: Ascorbic acid-mediated solid-state synthesis of cavity-engineered CuO–Cu2O–Cu heterostructures: structural transformation mechanism and photocatalytic detoxification of Cr(VI)
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,6377-6393
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09131D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mona S. NourEldien, Mostafa Y. Nassar
Ascorbic-acid-assisted reduction of CuO generates a CuO–Cu2O–Cu heterostructure with enhanced interfacial charge transfer. The Z-scheme pathway promotes ˙O2−-mediated visible-light-driven Cr(VI) reduction with high efficiency and stability.
